candidate_observations.address: Brislington Concourse, Bath Road, Bristol, BS4 5BQ
observed_facts: The property is marketed with gross annual income of £189,227 and four vacant units across 23 shops and one flat.
Several occupancies are holding over, at will or subject to 2026-2027 breaks, so the headline is not a single long-secure lease.
The interest is held on two Bristol City Council leases with approximately 69 and 71 years remaining at total ground rent of £10,200.
A 2023 feasibility study considered 96 apartments and eight shops; the source does not state that planning permission was granted.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No net income, sale price, planning permission or development value was inferred. Superior ground rent and vacant units were kept separate from the gross headline.

candidate_observations.address: 12-14 Butcher Row and 6-7 Ox Row, Salisbury, Wiltshire, SP1 1EP
observed_facts: Costa Limited, company 01270695, is active and pays £63,000 under a ten-year lease from 23 June 2017.
The occupational lease reverts on 22 June 2027.
The first and second floors provide 2,247 square feet of vacant self-contained restaurant and office accommodation.
The Grade II listed upper floors have residential conversion potential only subject to necessary consents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £63,000 rent was not projected beyond June 2027. Vacant upper floors were not assigned income, planning permission or residential value.

candidate_observations.address: Holland and Barrett, 253 High Street, Bangor, Clwyd, LL57 1PB
observed_facts: Holland & Barrett Retail Limited, company 02758955, is active and pays £18,000.
The five-year lease began on 24 February 2026 and nominally reverts on 23 February 2031.
The lease provides a tenant option to determine on the third anniversary of the term.
The interest is held on two 999-year leases at peppercorn rents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £18,000 income was not treated as secure through 2031 without qualification for the third-anniversary break. Peppercorn rents were not counted as income.

candidate_observations.address: High Newham Court, Stockton-on-Tees, County Durham, TS19 8PD
observed_facts: The £46,334 headline spans occupational retail rents, residential ground rents, a CCTV licence and a substation rent.
Units 22a and 22b are vacant, while several retail and residential interests are held on long leases at peppercorn.
Some occupational leases allow the landlord to determine on three months notice, and one tenant is stated not to be trading from the property.
The precinct includes 12 retail units and 27 residential units held on long leases.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The mixed headline was not presented as one covenant or one uniform lease term. Vacant units, deposits, peppercorns and termination rights were preserved without inferred rent or value.

candidate_observations.address: Yates, 19-21 Silver Street, Halifax, West Yorkshire, HX1 1HS
observed_facts: Stonegate Pub Company Limited, company FC029833, is active and pays £131,127.
The 35-year lease runs to 28 August 2032 without breaks.
The 2022 tenant break was not exercised.
The five-yearly upward-only review dated 29 August 2025 remains outstanding.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No reviewed rent or uplift was calculated. The unexercised 2022 break was not treated as extending the lease beyond August 2032.

candidate_observations.status: May lot Deferred; July relist Available at £415,000
observed_facts: The May 2026 lot ACUITUS-5748 was Deferred.
The same property was relisted in July 2026 as ACUITUS-5810, Available at a £415,000 guide.
The 1,255-square-foot property is vacant and held for 999 years from March 1999 at £200 annual rent.
Full residential conversion remains subject to consents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The deferred record was not treated as a sale. The July listing was linked but kept as a separate Acuitus identity; no planning permission, rental income or development value was inferred.
